title: Malévola storms A Fazenda 18 gates, causing a commotion
subtitle: The content creator tries to grab the director's attention and faces criticism for using fireworks and trespassing
excerpt: Malévola Alves tried to trespass at the A Fazenda 18 ranch, set off fireworks, and was stopped by security, sparking backlash and criticism over her actions.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the night of September 15, influencer Malévola Alves arrived at the A Fazenda 18 headquarters in Itapecerica da Serra and attempted to trespass into the reality show's perimeter. The incident gained attention as it involved a megaphone, fireworks, and a confrontation with the security team.

What motivated the intrusion attempt

Malévola claimed she was on a public street and demanded her right to be there, shouting at director Rodrigo Carelli. She asserted that her spot on the 18th season should have been guaranteed due to the controversies she was involved in throughout the year.

How the confrontation unfolded

As they approached the main gates, the content creator and her friend Ray Pugliese were stopped by security. Malévola blurted out, "Come near me and you'll see, I'll slap you in the face," and then ordered her companion, "Bring the bomb." When an agent tried to touch Ray, Malévola reacted: "Stop touching women. Are you crazy? Idiot."

Original plan with a helicopter

According to the influencer herself, the initial goal was to land a helicopter inside the show's facilities during the premiere. She said she had already sent a car with four security guards to scout the area and that she had the contact number for Record's helipad. The plan was abandoned due to legal issues, after consulting a criminal defense lawyer.

Reactions from other influencers

Influencer Amanda Fróes harshly criticized Malévola's attitude, saying she "only knows how to cause drama" and that using fireworks "scared the animals and neighbors." Fróes also questioned the lack of a "trans quota" on the show and accused Malévola of "stalking" by flying over gated communities.

Impact on animals and the community

The use of fireworks sparked concern regarding the welfare of horses, sheep, and other animals kept on the rural property. Local residents also reported being disturbed by the noise and the unexpected commotion at the gates of A Fazenda.

Developments and consequences

Malévola stated that her stunt at the gates generated more engagement than Record's show itself, saying: "This Fazenda isn't yielding anything. With this stunt, I yielded much more." The episode fueled the debate regarding the presence of influencers in television production environments and the need for prior authorization for external interventions.

With information from Terra, Metrópoles.
